items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Eight of the 14 vulnerabilities are rated Critical, with the highest CVSS score of 9.6.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie, affecting all versions before 1.11.12.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686, CVSS 8.7) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653, CVSS 8.7) leading to arbitrary file system write.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, bypassing validation. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix, but older versions remain vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and access store data. It includes 19 CVEs, with six rated Critical.
